trigger.description: SRR6.46.3 auto-enrollment detected a sibling process already holding the workspace's auto-enrollment advisory lock — typically a parallel `ee mesh auto-enroll` invocation, the SRR6.46.5 daemon job racing the foreground CLI, or a stale lockfile from a prior crashed process. Auto-enrollment refuses to interleave two materialization attempts onto the same workspace; the second caller backs off and surfaces the contention so the operator can serialize the work.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json &   # first invocation acquires the lock
ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json     # second invocation hits the concurrent guard
